tasks.title: Nmap MSSQL Scan
tasks.description: Basic port and script scan to identify MSSQL instances and domain info.

tasks.title: Password Spraying (CME / NetExec)
tasks.description: Spray known user lists and custom wordlists against the MSSQL service.

tasks.title: Impacket MSSQL Client
tasks.description: Connect to the MSSQL instance. Append -windows-auth if using Windows credentials rather than native SQL logins.

tasks.title: Impersonate Logins & Users
tasks.description: Once authenticated, check if you can impersonate higher-privileged accounts like 'sa'.
commands: SELECT distinct b.name FROM sys.server_permissions a INNER JOIN sys.server_principals b ON a.grantor_principal_id = b.principal_id WHERE a.permission_name = 'IMPERSONATE';

tasks.title: Enumerate Linked Servers
tasks.description: Hunt for trusted database links that allow you to execute commands on remote servers.

tasks.title: Enable & Run xp_cmdshell
tasks.description: If you have sysadmin privileges (or impersonated them), enable xp_cmdshell to execute system commands.

tasks.title: Hash Capture (xp_dirtree)
tasks.description: Force the SQL server to authenticate to your Kali machine to capture the service account's NTLM hash.

tasks.title: Extract Sensitive Files
tasks.description: Use NetExec/CrackMapExec to reach into the file system and pull down sensitive files (like SAM hives or backups) if you have the rights.
